{{Top|leg}}
'''Biotic vats''' were part of a [[Starship/Legends|starship's]] waste recycling system. They were filled with steaming [[enzymatic acid]] that broke down organic waste and refuse into its component cellular nutrients. Each vat had a hatch on the side where nonusable substances such as [[Plastic/Legends|plastics]] and [[Metal/Legends|metals]] were ejected from the unit.<ref name="EGTD">''[[The Essential Guide to Droids]]''</ref>
